name: ViewFlare
tagline: Serverless view counter and SVG badges on Cloudflare.
summary: A serverless telemetry counter for projects and documentation, built on Cloudflare Workers and D1 with a Hono API. One POST increments a project's views and one image URL renders a live SVG badge, so a repository gets usage counts without anyone running a backend. Formerly published as CFlair-Counter.
highlights: Integrates in one request: a single POST increments a counter, and a single image URL renders the badge.
Generates SVG badges with configurable style and colour, so it drops into an existing README badge row.
Persists to Cloudflare D1 with optional unique-visitor analytics, and admin endpoints for project-level operations.
Endpoint behaviour is checked continuously in CI rather than only at deploy time.
Serves the live view counters on several of the other projects listed here.
